Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is a computational re-analysis and validation of existing immunopeptidomics datasets. It focuses on the identification and estimation of proteasomal spliced peptides (PSPs) within the HLA-I ligandome across different cell types/tissues (Melanoma, B cell line, Fibroblasts). There is no experimental perturbation (treatment vs control) applied by the authors to the biological samples; rather, it is a descriptive characterization of the ligandome. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
